hook_text: Before trains and trucks, a team of sixteen oxen could pull a wagon full of goods all the way to the diamond fields, at walking speed.
clip_script: A long line of oxen leans into their yokes, pulling a heavy wagon with a white canvas cover across the dry veld. The driver cracks a long whip in the air, and a young boy walks in front, leading the oxen. They travel slowly, only about as fast as a person walks. Behind them, a coach pulled by galloping horses rattles past, full of passengers and mailbags. This was transport on land, before engines, powered by animals.
visual_style: Whiteboard drawings of a sledge, a donkey cart, an ox-wagon with a long span of oxen, and a horse-drawn coach, each labelled with what it carried.
mood: Dusty and adventurous, like a long journey across the veld.
pacing: Slow, steady build like the oxen walking, then speed up with the galloping coach.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look out for a donkey cart or a horse on your next trip.
